name: builtmighty/mighty-backup
description: WordPress plugin for automated site backups to DigitalOcean Spaces

_comment: aws/aws-sdk-php lists the ONLY AWS service namespaces kept in vendor/.
src/<Client> and src/data/<model> pair, which is what keeps vendor/ small.
The pruner also force-keeps Kms, SSO, SSOOIDC, Sts and Signin (~171 KB).
IMPORTANT: the prune is one-way. Composer decides what to install from
vendor/composer/installed.json, not from file presence, so a plain
`composer install` will NOT restore a deleted service. To add a service,
list it here AND run `composer reinstall aws/aws-sdk-php`.
